plan.provenance: extracted (vector PDF, CTM-mapped, scale derived from sheet) — needs-verification — MERGED from TWO stacked plan views registered by shared grid columns

notes.footprint: Union envelope (bbox) of two stacked wings registered via shared grid columns; NOT a single enclosed wall trace. Overlap band at the match line is NOT deduplicated (deduping could erase real geometry); flagged needs-verification.
notes.rooms: Best-effort geometric room segmentation: enclosed interior voids of the extracted wall network (occupancy-grid flood fill), classified by nearest text label. NOT a verified room schedule; NOT AHJ/PE/AutoSprink parity. Unlabeled spaces are kind "unknown" at low confidence. Deterministic given segments + scale.
notes.stairs: Best-effort stair-core detection: rooms classified "stair" by label, plus tight enclosed rooms containing a STAIR text token. NOT verified egress geometry; NOT AHJ/PE parity. Deterministic.
notes.merge: Two plan views on one sheet merged: wing B (upper) translated by (dx=-57.0253, dy=-111.6844) ft onto wing A (lower) using shared grid columns [1,2,3,4,5,6,7,8,9,16,17,18,19,20,21,22,23] (method=shared-grid-columns(consensus)+wall-bbox-bottom-edge-Y(equal-height), confidence=medium). needs-verification.

stackedSplit.note: Stacked-plan-view split: detects TWO plan views drawn on one sheet (a match-line break) via a Y-occupancy valley between two dense humps, so BOTH wings of an over-length floor are extracted (not just the denser one). Deterministic; the split Y is the deepest valley between the two largest geometry humps. needs-verification.

notes.doors: Geometric door detection: swing ARCS (bezier curves circle-fit to a ~2-4 ft leaf radius swept ~quarter turn) recovered from the plan vector ops; arc center = hinge = door position, radius = leaf width, start->end = swing. Nearest wall within 3 ft = host. Best-effort, deterministic; NOT a verified door/hardware schedule; NOT AHJ/egress parity. needs-verification.
notes.openings: Geometric opening detection: gaps (2.5-8 ft) between two near-collinear wall ends with no door arc on them = cased opening / passage. Best-effort, deterministic; needs-verification.
notes.fixtures: Fixture/core detection: restroom/mech/elevator/stair/elec/trash space content located + counted from segmented-room kinds and text-label tokens inside rooms. Best-effort, deterministic; NOT a verified fixture schedule; NOT AHJ/PE parity. needs-verification.

notes.footprint: Heuristic building-OUTLINE polygon (T33): from the extracted vector segments, only WALL-LIKE segments are kept (axis-aligned within a small angle tolerance AND at least minWallFt long), which drops short dimension witness-lines, text strokes and hatching; the DOMINANT connected wall NETWORK (segments joined end-to-end within connectTolFt, largest by total wall length) is isolated, dropping detached detail / legend / title geometry; the network is rasterized onto a gridN occupancy grid, the exterior is flood-filled, and the ENCLOSED footprint (wall + interior cells) is traced into a rectilinear polygon whose SHOELACE area is the reported footprint. This is the building footprint AREA (not the over-capturing bbox of the whole annotated sheet). It is a BEST-EFFORT APPROXIMATION — NOT a precise building outline, NOT a room segmentation, and NOT an AHJ/PE/accurate drawing. The minWallFt / connectTolFt / gridN thresholds are GEOMETRIC defaults (wall length, join tolerance, raster resolution) — they are NOT fitted to any target area or dollar figure. No scale guessing: coords are already in feet (operator-supplied scale applied upstream). Deterministic.
notes.rooms: Best-effort geometric room segmentation: enclosed interior voids of the extracted wall network (occupancy-grid flood fill), classified by nearest text label. notes.stairCores: Geometric stair-core detection: clusters of UP/DN/DOWN direction tokens validated by dense short tread-hatch segments nearby. notes.footprint: Heuristic building-OUTLINE polygon (T33): from the extracted vector segments, only WALL-LIKE segments are kept (axis-aligned within a small angle tolerance AND at least minWallFt long), which drops short dimension witness-lines, text strokes and hatching; the DOMINANT connected wall NETWORK (segments joined end-to-end within connectTolFt, largest by total wall length) is isolated, dropping detached detail / legend / title geometry; the network is rasterized onto a gridN occupancy grid, the exterior is flood-filled, and the ENCLOSED footprint (wall + interior cells) is traced into a rectilinear polygon whose SHOELACE area is the reported footprint. This is the building footprint AREA (not the over-capturing bbox of the whole annotated sheet). It is a BEST-EFFORT APPROXIMATION — NOT a precise building outline, NOT a room segmentation, and NOT an AHJ/PE/accurate drawing. The minWallFt / connectTolFt / gridN thresholds are GEOMETRIC defaults (wall length, join tolerance, raster resolution) — they are NOT fitted to any target area or dollar figure. No scale guessing: coords are already in feet (operator-supplied scale applied upstream). Deterministic.
notes.rooms: Best-effort geometric room segmentation: enclosed interior voids of the extracted wall network (occupancy-grid flood fill), classified by nearest text label. NOT a verified room schedule; NOT AHJ/PE/AutoSprink parity. Unlabeled spaces are kind "unknown" at low confidence. Deterministic given segments + scale.
notes.stairs: Best-effort stair-core detection: rooms classified "stair" by label, plus tight enclosed rooms containing a STAIR text token. NOT verified egress geometry; NOT AHJ/PE parity. Deterministic.
notes.stairCores: Geometric stair-core detection: clusters of UP/DN/DOWN direction tokens validated by dense short tread-hatch segments nearby. Reads the drawing convention (hatched shaft + run-direction annotation) because overall plans rarely carry a "STAIR" word. Best-effort, deterministic; NOT verified egress geometry; NOT AHJ/PE parity.
